name: Green's Bakery & Sandwich Shop
address: 3065 18th Ave S, St. Petersburg, FL 33712, United States
has_own_site_evidence: Google Business Profile shows no website field (raw page snippet includes 'Add website' and 'Claim this business', confirmed live via scripts/gmaps_detail.js). Domain checks: greensbakery.com redirects to an unrelated brand (greensbabka.com, a different babka bakery, not this business); greensbakerystpete.com, greensbakeryandsandwichshop.com and greensbakerysandwichshop.com all return 502/no live site. WebSearch for "Green's Bakery" "St Petersburg" / 18th Ave S turned up no official website, Facebook or Instagram for this specific business (closest unrelated hits were other St. Pete bakeries like Uhuru Food and Pies).

social_media.evidence: WebSearch for "Green's Bakery" St Petersburg plus email/facebook/instagram returned no matching profile for this business. No social links on the Google Business Profile.

email_search_note: No public email found. Checked: Google Business Profile (no email field, no website to pull a contact page from), WebSearch for the business name plus the street address (no Facebook/Instagram/website surfaced), domain guesses (none resolve to this business). Consistent with a small cash-only, one-day-a-week operation with no online presence beyond its Google listing.

google_business.hours_note: Live Google hours (captured during Thanksgiving week) show the business closed Mon/Tue/Wed/Fri/Sat/Sun and open only Thursday 12:30-6 PM; that specific time window is flagged by Google as holiday-adjusted so it is NOT used as a general claim on the site. What IS used, and is corroborated independently: 'Thursday only' is explicitly called out by name in 8 separate Google review snippets (serviceMentions from gmaps_detail.js), and review text repeats it ('They are only open Thursdays'). Exact normal weekly open/close times were not confirmed from a non-holiday source, so the site states 'Thursdays only' without inventing specific hours, and tells visitors to call ahead.

payment_note: Cash only: called out by name in 3 separate Google review snippets ('cash only, mentioned in 3 reviews') and consistent with the lack of any online ordering/payment presence.

soul_food_plates: Neck bones with lima beans and cabbage
Beef stew with carrots and green beans
sandwiches: Hot deli-style subs (turkey seen in research photo) with lettuce, pickles and mustard
services.pricing_note: No prices published online anywhere (no website, no menu board photo close enough to read numbers). Reviews describe prices only qualitatively ('such reasonable prices'). Site does not display any invented price and instead directs visitors to call ahead, per the adapted-variant rule in FORGE-BRIEF 0.b.
